mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jobs (external_id, workspace_uuid, type, status, payload) VALUES ( concat('job_', replace(CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS text), '-', '')), #{workspaceUUID}, 'object_cleanup', 'pending', CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb) )
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN status ELSE 'pending' END, run_after = CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN run_after ELSE NOW() END, locked_by = CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN locked_by ELSE NULL END, locked_until = CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN locked_until ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE external_id = #{externalID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'

WITH next_jobs AS ( SELECT uuid FROM jobs WHERE type = 'object_cleanup' AND run_after <= now() AND ( status IN ('pending', 'retry') OR (status = 'running' AND locked_until < now()) ) ORDER BY run_after, created_at LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE jobs j SET status = 'running', locked_by = #{workerID}, locked_until = now() + interval '1 minute', updated_at = now() FROM next_jobs WHERE j.uuid = next_jobs.uuid RETURNING j.uuid, j.external_id, j.workspace_uuid, COALESCE(j.payload->>'bucket', '') AS bucket, COALESCE(j.payload->>'key', '') AS object_key, COALESCE(j.payload->>'file_id', '') AS file_external_id, j.attempts
UPDATE jobs SET status = 'completed', locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE uuid = #{jobUUID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'

UPDATE jobs SET status = #{params.Status}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, run_after = #{params.RunAfter}, updated_at = now(), attempts = #{params.Attempts}, payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('last_error', CAST(#{params.Reason} AS text)) WHERE uuid = #{params.JobUUID} AND type = 'object_cleanup'
